'''Fereden''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]], Fereden was part of the Imperial forces stationed at the [[Imperial Domination Outpost]] in the [[High Security Section]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sergeant Fereden appears as a Classic Gear Vendor for Imperial players on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
